Saved Views is here today, included in all paid plans at no extra cost. It lets you capture the exact filters, sorting, and grouping you use most, so you can return to any list instantly instead of rebuilding it every time.

Track overdue tasks, monitor a sprint backlog, or keep an eye on a client's board — save the setup once and it's ready whenever you need it. Each user can save up to 50 views, giving everyone plenty of space to organize work around their own projects and roles.

Views aren't just personal, either. Any saved view can be shared with your team, so teammates see the same filtered list without recreating it themselves. This keeps reporting consistent, speeds up onboarding, and cuts down on repeated explanations of how a board is organized.

Saved Views works across every project in your workspace and is ready to use right now.

Open any list and select Save view to get started.
